title: A spacetime positive mass theorem with corners via mollification
summary: We prove a strict dominant energy deformation theorem for asymptotically flat initial data with corners along a hypersurface $Σ$. The deformation preserves a corner condition on the Bartnik data across $Σ$. We show that if the dominant energy condition holds on each side of $Σ$ and the Bartnik data satisfy this corner condition, then the exterior end satisfies $E \ge |P|$ in every dimension $n \ge 3$.
